title: Everything You Need to Know About the New Dog Man Book
excerpt: Dog Man is back in another hilarious graphic novel by best-selling author Dav Pilkey. Learn more about the new Dog Man book and pre-order your copy today.
content:
Dog Man fans, it's time to get excited! After a year-long wait, the #1 worldwide best-selling author and illustrator Dav Pilkey is back with Dog Man: A Sprinkle in Time! This brand-new adventure is chock-full of the heroics, hilarity, and heart that kids adore about everyone's favorite canine superhero. 

Here's everything your family needs to know before release day.

  • Release date: November 3, 2026 
  • Best for: Grades 2–5+ or Ages 7–10+
  • Format: Hardcover graphic novel 

If you and your reader need a quick refresher, here's the story so far. The Dog Man graphic novel series chronicles the hilarious and vivid adventures of the “Supa Buddies.” There's Dog Man, a lovable hero who's part dog and part policeman. His friends include Li'l Petey, a curious, optimistic kitten and clone of Petey, and 80-HD, a robot who expresses himself best through his art. From hilarious hijinks to their pure insistence on goodness, these characters and so many others keep readers laughing and cheering.

In the previous book in the series, Dog Man: Big Jim Believes, the Space Cuties From Space returned, turning the heroes' world upside down. As Dog Man, Big Jim, Molly, and their friends worked to set things right, they learned that trust, teamwork, and a little positivity can go a supa long way.

Now, Dog Man and his friends are back for an all-new adventure. 

In the newest Dog Man saga, Grampa (Petey's troublemaking dad and a classic anti-hero in the series) alters the fabric of time and space, sending Dog Man and his friends on a wild adventure unlike any they've faced before. Along the way, our beloved heroes encounter surprising challenges that test their courage, teamwork, and determination to make a difference.

Filled with laugh-out-loud moments, epic action, and Dav Pilkey's signature storytelling, Dog Man: A Sprinkle in Time asks a big question: can even the smallest actions help shape the future?

Readers will be thrilled to reunite with favorite characters as they navigate twists, turns, and time-bending adventures that challenge them to grow, adapt, and rely on one another in new ways.

Pre-order Your Copy Today

Dog Man's story started long before it hit bookshelves. 

When award-winning author Dav Pilkey was a kid, he was diagnosed with ADHD and dyslexia. He was so disruptive in class that his teachers made him sit out in the hallway every day. Luckily, Pilkey loved to draw and make up stories, so he spent his time in the hallway creating his own original comic books — the very first adventures of Dog Man and Captain Underpants.

Dav Pilkey credits his parents as playing a key role in his success. “Dog Man started out as a character I created when I was in second grade, but the series has evolved into a love letter to my parents,” Pilkey said. “Looking back as a kid growing up with dyslexia and ADHD, my parents, who were my best advocates, let me choose whatever books I wanted to read — with no judgment. Their support and love was life-changing and helped me to become the reader, author, and illustrator that I am today.” 

Since those days dreaming up fun stories in the school hallway, Pilkey has gone on to become an award-winning author and illustrator of kids books, including the New York Times best-selling series’ Dog Man, Captain Underpants, and Cat Kid Comic Club. The universal appeal of Pilkey's books, which celebrate the triumph of the good-hearted, resonate with readers all over the world. His books have been translated into many languages and sold millions of copies across the globe.  

For many families, they're also the books that turn kids into the kind of readers who can't put a book down and in the process impart some truly important life lessons about friendship, family, goodness, and so much more.  

Whether you'll read book Dog Man: A Sprinkle in Time together or your reader can't wait to tear through it's pages on their own, conversation makes the experience of reading even richer. We can't devulge too many details, but these are a few questions inspired by the book's themes of friendship, teamwork, and making a difference. Try them while you count down to release day, or save them for after the last page. 

  • Which Dog Man character would you want on your team and why?
  • What would you do if you could travel through time?
  • When have you helped a friend solve a problem?
  • How can one of your small actions make a big difference?
  • What would you change if you could revisit a moment in the past?

Want more? The Dav Pilkey Books site offers free printable activity sheets (like these), How 2 Draw videos, and so much more.  And, if your reader loves creating comics as much as reading them, Dav Pilkey's Epic Comic Club is full of story starters and activities for budding creators.

It's not too late to catch up before November! Our complete guide to the series walks you through every book in order. 

Ready for the next adventure? Pre-order your copy of Dog Man A Sprinkle in Time today, so your reader is first in line for the fun.
